# Meownero

> Meownero (ticker: MEOW) is an independent proof-of-work cryptocurrency in development where every transaction is private by rule. There is no transparent transaction type. It will launch fairly with public notice before genesis, with no premine, no founder reward, and no developer tax. Nothing is for sale today: there is no token and no presale.

## What Meownero is

- An independent coin with its own chain, consensus, and peer-to-peer network. Not a token on another blockchain.
- Mandatory privacy: every transfer is shielded. Privacy is a rule of the protocol, not an option.
- Proof of work: coins enter circulation only through mining.
- Fair launch: reproducible binaries and public notice before genesis, then everyone mines.
- No premine, founder reward, or developer tax.

## Status

- The project is in the planning and engineering phase. No launch date has been announced.
- Any token called MEOW or Meownero being sold today is unrelated to this project.
